name: io.github.flumpiey/linkwarden-mcp
title: Linkwarden MCP
description: Read-first Linkwarden bookmarks MCP with opt-in write, delete, and collection tools.

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access token from Linkwarden settings (Authorization: Bearer)

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated write scopes: links,collections,tags,raw. Empty = read-only.

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated delete scopes (never implied by write scopes)
